brief:
A six-year-old Palestinian girl severely burned in Gaza has become entangled in an Israeli dispute over humanitarian assistance. Masa Yassin's injuries—burns covering her face, scalp, ear and neck—have drawn attention as the child's case intersects with broader disagreements over aid delivery to the territory, according to Reuters.

The girl's medical condition has surfaced amid ongoing disputes between Israeli authorities and Palestinian officials over how humanitarian aid reaches Gaza.
dek: By Nidal al-Mughrabi and Dawoud Abu Alkas CAIRO/GAZA, Nov 13 (Reuters) - The excruciating burns run around the side of Masa Yassin's tiny face, behind her ear, over her scalp and down her neck.
title: Six-year-old Gaza burn victim becomes focal point in Israeli aid dispute
